descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT 3.5; TFA-92592 AC 15 · “the Post-Round tab shows a "generating" state, and the note appears when ready whether or not the chart is open”.

Bug N17 · fixed on 8b4be94a · was S1 · no longer counted

Generation is not on the server: the note is still written and saved by the page, so a reload, a closed tab or a killed phone page loses a note the model already wrote; no 'generating' state on return, a failure while away is never shown, and the previous note stays on Post-Round as if it were today's

Tickets: TFA-92592 AC 15 · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: 'use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only billing to the server. Confirmed on dev (TC-14/S07 reload: Haiku answered, no note saved). Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: fixed: the note is a server job; reload or leaving during Generate shows a generating state, then the note (dev: OAT-03/S15, TC-14/S07, S26, TC-21/S28 10/10, TC-17/S27).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-14/S07, OAT-03/S15, TC-25/S14, TC-21/S28, TC-17/S27

Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S26 Slow and failed generation while the physician is away: a generating state while the call runs, the note or an explicit failure on return (both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Generation runs on the server: the physician can tap Generate and move to another patient; the Post-Round tab shows a 'generating' state, and on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows, … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.5; TFA-92592 AC 15) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T8 If both models fail, a clear error shows and the dictation is not lost (Empty & Failure States: 'Note not generated' shown, dictation kept; … (TFA-94422 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT OAT-03)
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fresh physician, two patients per mode as in S07. The runner controls the ai/notes:generateNote call: held about 15 s and then answered (cells H), or failed so that no model answers (cells F)

When Cell H, each mode: type the cell text, press Generate Note & Finish, open the second patient at once, return to the first within 2 s and open Post-Round; after the call is released, wait 5 s and look again. …

Then While the call is held, Post-Round shows a generating state, never only 'Complete the Encounter tab first' (UAT 3.5 and U4; OAT-03: the physician is never left waiting with nothing). After the release the note is there. When generation fails while the physician is away, on return an explicit failure shows and the dictation is on the Encounter tab

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint: the early checkpoint mustContainAny a generating marker ('Generating', 'Writing note') and mustNotContain 'Complete the Encounter tab first'; the late one carries the cell's blood pressure; the failure cells need an accepted failure string ('Note not generated', 'couldn’t be generated', 'could not be generated'; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-14/S26

Slow and failed generation while the physician is away: a generating state while the call runs, the note or an explicit failure on return (both modes)

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for qa); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

PW, local stack, both modes, generateNote mocked at the socket. Every Generate used a 'procedure-other' custom note template because on 43c38a4f saving a generated note queues a server billing job (billing/persistence.ts enqueueBilling → ai/billing.ts run) that no socket mock can answer and that would reach Bedrock on this stack; the template only changes the (mocked) model's instruction text. Tripwire: no model call at all during the run. Cell H (call held 15 s; the physician opens the second patient at once and comes straight back, ~0.95 s after the press): FAILED in both modes — while the call was still held Post-Round showed 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' (Hospital also the spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button, B27) and no generating state; 5 s after the release the note (129/73, 121/67) was there (passed). Cell F (Regenerate with new dictation fails 3 s after it is asked while the physician is away; back after 30 s): FAILED in both modes — no failure message anywhere (Post-Round or Encounter tab); Post-Round shows the earlier note as the current note while the stored encounter text is the new dictation (125/75, 119/65); the dictation is kept on the Encounter tab (passed). Judged 8/12 per mode pair (h1 and f1 fail in each mode). On 43c38a4f the note is still generated by the page: the browser calls ai/notes:generateNote, gets the text back and saves it with its own mutation (useNoteGeneration.ts finalize, snf EncounterTab.tsx handleGenerate); 'feat: use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only the billing suggestion to a server job (no scheduler use for notes anywhere in convex/). The failure message lives in the Encounter tab's component state and is lost when the chart is left. Dev confirmation of cell H: runs/2026-10-14-dev/newspec-c/results.gen.json TC-14/S26.

Product issue: After leaving a chart mid-Generate, Post-Round never shows that a note is being written ('No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.'), and when the generation fails while the physician is on another patient nothing says so: the previous note stays on Post-Round as if it were today's although the new dictation was never turned into a note.

Evidence: 10 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: fault-ai. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [dev newspec-c] passed (newspec-c/results.json) — newspec-c: passed → passed (passed) Dev (main 8b4be94a, deployed 2026-10-20 02:04 JST), live models, under runs/.dev.lock; only prefixed rows created and all deleted (0 remaining, 0 changes to other rows).
